model_name: 法鼓文理學院金山校本部大願橋
review_scope: Independent visual inspection of all five final rendered PNGs against previously personally inspected 17 source photographs; source-bound whole-exterior approximation only.
findings: Top view retains unequal curved side boundaries and a wider middle/narrower ends, rather than a constant-width repeated segment.
Front/rear/elevation/oblique views retain one outward-leaning high gray box wall, brown interior and bark-strip relief, a lower genuinely open opposing railing and transverse wood deck.
Two true through openings remain in the high wall near opposite ends, with visible thickness; they are not a pair of circular pedestrian portals.
Two near-bank groups of paired inclined tubes are visible and central span is pier-free. Upper connections are deliberately at different levels, rather than a forced common-apex A frame.
Exposed round-section transverse beam ends and underside members are represented, rather than the old flat decorative-rib/solid-soffit simplification.
Both bridge ends are present. Rectangular minimal end interfaces and display slab are explicitly non-site display supports, not surveyed banks/terrain.
limitations: Photographic approximation, not exact construction geometry or a 2026 condition survey.
Plan/profile curves, widths, wall heights/thickness, support positions/diameters/angles, hole dimensions and repeated member counts remain estimates.
Bark texture, upper wood-panel seams, small connectors and exact colors are simplified; no claim that each narrow piece was counted from photographs.
Hidden box girder/TMD, foundations, surrounding buildings, channel weirs and terrain are omitted.
This visual PASS does not waive thin-member/slicing/support risks, certify printability or structural safety, authorize publication, or convert old segment QA into new-model QA.
NCREE PDF was truncated/unreadable and not used as drawing evidence; contractor05/06 lower gray regions were excluded.
repository_actions: Only this private QA record and starting hash snapshot written; main repository, model geometry and uploads untouched.
